mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 40 degrees with clear skies at Harriet Park and a first quarter moon. The air quality is currently moderate with an index of 51. You can catch the International Space Station passing over tonight for 5 minutes starting at 6:30 AM, rising in the west-northwest over Cross Plains and traveling toward the northeast near the Home Depot.

The city is offering a Stormwater Utility Credit for property owners who install features like rain gardens or barrels to manage runoff. Also, the police department is currently looking to connect with certified law enforcement officers for potential future career opportunities.

We have plenty of fun on the horizon. Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus Brewing or at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or Wednesday trivia at The Bogey Factory.

Regarding the police report, on October 15, officers arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving while students were on board. Thankfully, no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor is the delicious Devil's Food Cake. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
